card.text: A spiral galaxy 17.6 million parsecs away, seen close to edge-on.

sources.label: Tully, Courtois & Sorce (2016), Cosmicflows-3, AJ 152, 50; CDS J/AJ/152/50, table 3, PGC 39028: distance modulus 31.23 ± 0.45 mag
HyperLEDA (Makarov et al. 2014), NGC4192 = PGC 39028: inclination 90°, major-axis position angle 152.4°, from its outline at 25 mag per square arcsecond
Wikipedia, "Messier 98"
sources.quote: Messier 98, M98 or NGC 4192 is an intermediate spiral galaxy about 44.4 million light-years away in slightly northerly Coma Berenices, about 6° to the east of the bright star Denebola.

introduction.text: Its picture is the Sloan Digital Sky Survey's, with the Milky Way's foreground stars removed, standing as a flat picture that faces the Sun.

sources.label: Sloan Digital Sky Survey; color HiPS CDS/P/SDSS9/color by T. Boch (CDS), cut out by the CDS hips2fits service
Wikipedia, "Messier 98"
sources.quote: It was discovered by French astronomer Pierre Méchain on 1781, along with nearby M99 and M100, and was catalogued by compatriot Charles Messier 29 days later in his Catalogue des Nébuleuses & des amas d'Étoiles.

optical.title: M98 in visible light
optical.summary: Visible-light image on a flat plane facing the Sun; nothing in it has depth.
